_help: Stations you add by hand (from add-station.html requests). Copy _example into stations, fill it in, then run: python tools/update_stations.py --extras-only  (or a full update). id must be unique, lowercase letters/numbers/dashes. lat/lng are optional: without them the city/province places the pin when the app knows the place. added is the date you list it (YYYY-MM-DD); it puts the station under the New filter for 60 days. name should include the frequency (e.g. 97.3 or 666) so the app files it under FM or AM. Optional "replaces": a list of old directory names for the same station; those listings are dropped.
